name: Icypeas
summary: Find and verify professional emails, search a people and company database, and scrape profile and company data.

api_key.description: An Icypeas API key (Icypeas dashboard > API). Sent as is in the Authorization header, no Bearer prefix.

notes: Every call but the two scrape GETs is a POST.
Single email and domain searches are asynchronous: they return an _id; read the result with results.read or a webhook.
Credits: email search 1 and domain search 1 when found, verification 0.1, lead database about 0.02 per result, profile or company scrape from 0.5.
The multi-row url-search, scrape and reverse-lookup batch endpoints are not in this entry.

endpoints.name: Get subscription and credits
endpoints.summary: Plan and credit balance of a user.
notes: A read over POST: starts a search, changes nothing.

endpoints.name: Find an email from a name and domain
endpoints.summary: Email of a person at a company.

firstname.description: First name; may be empty if lastname is set.

lastname.description: Last name; may be empty if firstname is set.

custom.description: Optional {webhookUrl, externalId}: a webhook for this search and your own id.

notes: A read over POST: starts a search, changes nothing.
Asynchronous: returns a search _id at once; read the result a few seconds later with icypeas.results.read (mode single), or set custom.webhookUrl.
1 credit when an email is found.

0.1 credit per verification (per the docs overview).

endpoints.name: Start a bulk email search
endpoints.summary: Bulk domain search, email search or email verification, up to 5,000 rows.

data.description: Rows: email-search rows have three items (first name, last name, domain or company); the other tasks one item.

notes: Starts a job that only produces data. Track it with icypeas.bulk.progress and read rows with icypeas.results.read (mode bulk, file id).
Charged per row at the single-search rate.

notes: A read over POST: starts a search, changes nothing.
